entities.name: Pridvorica Monastery
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Pridvorica Monastery is a monastery of the Serbian Orthodox Church, built in the 12th century, at the same time as the nearby Studenica. It has the status of cultural monument of great importance. It is located in the village of Pridvorica, Ivanjica.
